subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Fake Police Call
description: A quick, practical guide to The Fake Police Call.

hook.text: An officer calls saying your Social Security number was used in a crime. You need to verify it now.

buildup.text: Callers pose as police, FBI, or SSA agents, claiming your identity has been compromised.

discovery.text: They ask you to 'verify' your SSN, date of birth, and bank details — giving them everything.

twist.text: Real law enforcement never asks for Social Security numbers or payment over the phone.

climax.text: Once they have your SSN, they can open accounts, file tax returns, and steal your identity.

punchline.text: Verifying your identity to a scammer means giving it away.

quiz.question: Do real police officers ask for Social Security numbers over the phone?
